title: SEC2: reader drain acquire_many efficiency
description: Reader drain semaphore acquire_many(max_connections) is acceptable at shutdown. In crates/reader/src/main.rs lines 331-353, the drain block calls semaphore_drain.acquire_many(max_connections as u32). Tokio acquire_many queues one waiter and wakes atomically; it does not iterate over idle permits. Cost is one atomic operation regardless of idle permit count. Runs once per server lifetime so no performance concern. Alternative: tokio::sync::Notify plus AtomicUsize connection counter avoids semaphore involvement at drain entirely, but the delta is immeasurable at shutdown. Separate correctness observation out of efficiency scope: sem2 (NNTPS semaphore, line 303) is never drained, so NNTPS sessions are not waited on during shutdown.
notes: opinion: This is a confirmatory 'no issue' note, not a finding. It verifies that acquire_many is efficient and adds zero actionable work. The secondary observation about NNTPS semaphore not being drained is already captured as a separate P1 finding (nzr6.8). No engineering basis for keeping this as an open issue.
